items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: persuaded Mr. E--- to give us a tryout. Then we went down and tried out and he gave us a two week contract.

ctx.x: band was from families that could well-afford to give them what they wanted, but we didn't. We were determined to make it on our own. Anyway, we left there and went into Dallas. And we were playing out a place called Oak Cliff.
Oak Cliff, yeah. And we were playing at this ballroom, big, big ballroom and one of the head bellmen at the -----he was crazy about the band and he had Mr. E----who was the manager have his secretary
